question: On 26 March 2025, where was the 8th State Level Coordination Committee (SLCC) meeting conducted by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gangtok**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **8th State Level Coordination Committee (SLCC) meeting** was conducted by the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** on **26 March 2025** in **Gangtok, Sikkim**.
 
• SLCC meetings are held to review and coordinate measures for combating illegal deposit-taking activities in the respective states.
 
• The event involves participation from **state government officials, regulators, and law enforcement agencies**.
 
• Gangtok, the capital of Sikkim, hosted the meeting to address state-specific financial and regulatory concerns.
 
• The SLCC serves as a key platform to enhance inter-agency coordination and protect the public from fraudulent financial schemes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **State Level Coordination Committee (SLCC)**

 
 
• SLCC is an inter-regulatory body chaired by the RBI, established to address **unauthorized deposit activities** in states.
 
• The committee includes representatives from SEBI, IRDAI, state governments, and law enforcement agencies.
 
• It monitors entities involved in potentially illegal financial activities and facilitates timely action.
 
 
 
• **Role of RBI in Financial Regulation**
 
 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is the central bank responsible for **monetary policy, financial stability, and supervision of banks** in India.
 
• It also safeguards consumers by combating fraudulent schemes through regulatory measures and public awareness campaigns.
 
 
 
• **Gangtok - Key Highlights**
 
 
• Gangtok is the capital city of Sikkim, a northeastern state in India known for its picturesque landscapes and cultural heritage.
 
• It serves as a hub for governance, tourism, and regional development activities in the state.
 
• Gangtok is also an important venue for hosting government and regulatory meetings due to its strategic location.
 
 
 
• **Public Awareness Initiatives**
 
 
• RBI conducts various initiatives to educate the public about **fraudulent financial schemes** and encourages reporting suspicious activities.
 
• Awareness campaigns through media and public outreach programs are crucial in combating illegal deposit collection.
